audit_notes: 9020 matrix rows include 451 WT-to-WT rows; 8569 are nonself substitutions.
Original source target has modeled entity positions 1-167 and 171-216. Missing entity positions 168-170 and 217-221 must not be collapsed when highlighting this MOS object.
Original auth PD-L1 numbering is label_seq_id + 17 (e.g. C44 maps to auth A61). The raw overview contains a contradictory +18 note and incorrect modeled-span lists; use this verified atom-site map.
Original VL modeled positions are 2-109, not 2-108.
Raw narrative calls 2293 square A burial on PD-L1; that figure sums both sides of the VH–PD-L1 pair. Use explicit per-side numbers or their mean.
ANARCI best-hit species is an HMM classification signal and is not the actual origin of the therapeutic antibody.
Recommended mutations and composite scores are computational heuristics, not experimentally validated improvements.
